reference.text: Matthew is such a sympathetic listener.

underlines.text: needn’t stop to discourse with sympathetic listeners on your way, either

reference.text: I can’t cook, as you know, Marilla, and—and—I don’t mind going to a picnic without puffed sleeves so much, but I’d feel terribly humiliated if I had to go without a basket.
Now, get out your patchwork and have your square done before teatime.”
“Oh, Marilla,” she exclaimed breathlessly, “there’s going to be a Sunday-school picnic next week—in Mr. Harmon Andrews’s field, right near the lake of Shining Waters.

underlines.text: They’re going to have boats on the Lake of Shining Waters—and ice cream

reference.text: “Now, just for curiosity’s sake, see if you can hold your tongue for the same length of time.”
